items.source: Implementations do not need to concern themselves with DriverExceptions that may be thrown from operations they attempt. The CqlTemplate class will catch and handle DriverExceptions appropriately.
items.translation: 实现无需关心从它们尝试执行的操作中可能抛出的DriverException。 CqlTemplate 类将捕获并适当处理这些DriverException。

items.source: Classes implementing this interface should also implement the CqlProvider interface if it is able to provide the CQL it uses for PreparedStatement creation. This allows for better contextual information in case of exceptions.
items.translation: 实现此接口的类如果能够提供用于创建 `PreparedStatement` 的 CQL，则还应实现CqlProvider接口。这样在发生异常时可以提供更丰富的上下文信息。
